overall_goal: Chop vegetables and add them to a salad bowl with beans

goals.rationale: The person retrieves a Tupperware container, a chopping board, and a plate to set up the workspace for preparing the salad.

goals.description: Chop the cucumber and add it to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a cucumber, cuts it, weighs it, slices it into pieces, and transfers the chopped cucumber into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Chop the cherry tomatoes and add them to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person grabs cherry tomatoes, slices them into halves and quarters, and scrapes them from the chopping board into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Peel and chop the carrot, then add it to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person weighs and peels a carrot, cuts it into smaller diced pieces, and transfers the chopped carrot into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Chop the coriander and add it to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person measures out coriander, chops it on the board, and scoops the pieces into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Chop the red onion and add it to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person cuts a red onion, weighs it, peels the layers, slices it into smaller pieces, and scrapes the chopped onion into the salad bowl.

goals.description: Add beans to the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person scoops beans from a Tupperware container and adds them to the salad bowl to mix with the chopped vegetables.
